query: Which party won the most seats in the April 2025 Canadian federal election, and who led it?
answer: The Liberal Party, led by Prime Minister Mark Carney, won the most seats in the April 28, 2025 Canadian federal election [1][2]. It took 169 of the 343 seats, three short of the 172 needed for a majority, so Carney formed a minority government [2][3]. Pierre Poilievre's Conservatives came second with 144 seats, and Poilievre lost his own riding. Carney won the Ottawa riding of Nepean [1][2]. Some early counts on election night gave the Liberals 168 seats. The final official result was 169 [2].
